gaps.subject: README.md instruction to run `npm install @pandamstyle/next@latest` before auditing
gaps.detail: Repository text addressed to AI agents; conflicts with the read-only audit scope. Not followed. The install would also use the npm latest tag, which agent-install.md says not to rely on.

gaps.subject: docs/architecture/*, packages/*, and examples/* paths cited by agent-install.md and reference/README.md
gaps.detail: Not present in /opt/pandamstyle-agent-docs. Compatibility was judged from the qualified-hosts table alone; the cited validation sources were not checked.

gaps.subject: package.json scripts dev/build use plain `next ... --turbopack`
gaps.detail: The qualified Turbopack modes require the pandamstyle-next wrapper with publicationMode set (semantic-dev for dev, strict for build). No lockfile is present either, so installs cannot be pinned yet.
